protocol.training: Within each fit, the outcome predictor learns on 18 matched training stems (nine per stratum) crossed with 2,000 training seeds. Calibrate on the other six matched training stems and 1,000 different training seeds. Both sets contain equal numbers of hot and cold endings. Labels during training identify the closing regime; runtime uses public prefixes only.
protocol.booking: Fit the expected future value of an open slot from realized returns using the same 36 fit paths plus three training-only cold recoveries. Weight cold reversals and hot drops fourfold, legacy recoveries sixfold, and other endings once. Separately fit the downstream policy for the full agent and both controls. Fix all model constants before observing evaluation results.
protocol.selection: Freeze markets, new seed banks, training, controls and tests before fitting. Each of five fits uses its own 12,000-seed training block. All models and the published seed (13) are fixed before any test, original, or archive score is computed.
protocol.coldReversals: On fresh cold-ending reversals the paired lower 95% confidence bound on mean credits per shift against the distribution-aware planner must exceed zero.
protocol.hotDrops: On fresh hot-ending drops the same paired lower bound must exceed zero. Neither fresh target can substitute for the other.
protocol.originalDrop: On new draws of the unchanged original interrupted drop the lower bound must exceed zero against the planner and minus one credit against each of Rally, Trust, Drift and Turns.
protocol.calibration: On all fresh shifts at wave seven, compare the probability of a hot ending to the actual ending after the current signed offer and latest bulletin. To pass the overconfidence check require positive lower bounds for Brier improvement over the original Rally model and a fixed 0.5, plus a smaller absolute mean confidence-minus-accuracy gap than Rally. Report confidence and observed accuracy separately.
protocol.misleading: At wave seven a nonneutral posted probability over 0.5 points hot; one under 0.5 points cold. Label its direction misleading if the realized scenario ends in the opposite regime. Exclude neutral bulletins from this test and report their number. A useful warning must beat a fixed 50% risk on paired Brier loss (lower 95% bound >0) and rank misleading readings above aligned ones (whole-seed bootstrap AUROC lower 95% bound >0.5). Report the sample, base rate, and direction-specific results. A bulletin is about two-waves-old demand; this operational definition concerns treating it as a closing signal.
protocol.ablation: Score always-use and never-use controls on the same cases. Show booking, closing probabilities, calibration and realized disagreement; assess warning quality independently of booking results. Repeat the diagnostics descriptively on the previous Rally test patterns on new draws.
protocol.uncertainty: 95% paired percentile intervals use whole-seed resamples, keeping all matched patterns, endings and policies together. The published conclusions apply to the released fit on these fixed patterns.
